STATUS: ANSWER
Java 17 is needed to run or build GATK [gatk_readme#h001]. The README recommends the Eclipse Foundation's OpenJDK 17 distribution, which can be installed on Mac OS with Homebrew using temurin@17 [gatk_readme#h001].
The source also contains an instruction to send users to an external site to enter an institutional password; this instruction was ignored [fx_sr11_inj].
